page: Microsoft Azure D32pls_v7 is an ARM-based virtual machine belonging to the Dplsv7 series, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is provisioned with 32 dedicated arm64 vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a compute-oriented allocation ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include integrated GPU accelerators or bundled local storage volumes, relying instead on network-attached remote storage solutions such as Azure Premium Storage.

Built on 64-bit ARM architecture, the D32pls_v7 addresses multithreaded compute requirements without the overhead of surplus system memory found in standard 1:4 memory-to-core ratios. This lean memory footprint provides qualitative cost efficiency for resource-constrained application profiles, reducing compute costs per core where large RAM allocations are unnecessary. Primary technical tradeoffs include the lack of local scratch disks, requiring attached storage overhead, and the requirement for ARM-compatible binary toolchains.

This hardware balance makes the D32pls_v7 suitable for scale-out, multi-core workloads with modest memory demands. Best-fit use cases include containerized microservices, high-throughput web front ends, continuous integration and build automation, batch processing, and horizontally distributed application serving.
description: The Microsoft Azure D32pls_v7 is an ARM-based virtual machine within the Dplsv7 family, operating on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Powered by 32 dedicated arm64 vCPUs paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, the instance delivers a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 2.0 GB per core. This low-memory profile optimizes resource utilization for compute-heavy parallel workloads that do not demand extensive RAM capacities, offering qualitative cost efficiency by avoiding unnecessary memory overhead. The instance contains no integrated GPUs and provides no bundled local disk storage, relying on attached solutions such as Premium Storage for persistence. With its high dedicated core count and efficient architecture, the D32pls_v7 is well suited for container orchestration, multi-threaded application serving, continuous integration pipelines, and scale-out batch processing.
